impact_summary.value: HPLC 시스템의 날짜·시간 설정을 사용자가 변경할 수 있고 크로마토그래피 데이터의 삭제가 가능해 전자 데이터와 분석 결과의 무결성·정확성·신뢰성에 위험이 있습니다. 안정성 프로그램에 검증된 분석 시험법이 정의되거나 연결되어 있지 않아 안정성 데이터의 신뢰성과 제품 품질 및 유효기간 뒷받침이 충분히 보장되지 않는다고 지적되었습니다.

evidence.quote: The ability to alter system date and time settings creates a risk to the integrity, accuracy, and reliability of electronic data, including analytical test results and audit trail information generated by the chromatographic data system.

The absence of defined and validated test methods within, or cross-referenced by, the stability program does not ensure that stability testing is performed using appropriate, validated procedures, and therefore does not provide adequate assurance of the reliability and accuracy of stability data generated to support product quality and expiry dating.

evidence.quote: the desktop computer connected to your firm's only HPLC system, which utilizes (b) (4) software to perform ingredient assay and impurity testing for all OTC drug products

Your data acquisition sofiware and workstations, the systems used for your chromatography instruments, have not been suitably qualified to ensure that the data generated for routine release of incoming and final drug products are maintained and free of manual manipulation or deletion.
Your firm's written stability procedure, SOP 2-0102, Revision 17, effective December 11, 2025, titled "Stability Program," identifies required stability parameters

observations.title: Birchwood Laboratories, LLC — 21 CFR 211.68(b) Computer control of master formula records
observations.ai_summary: FDA API 관찰사항 기준, Birchwood Laboratories, LLC는 마스터 제조·관리기록과 기타 기록의 변경을 승인된 인원만 수행하도록 컴퓨터시스템 통제를 확보하지 못했습니다. 또한 안정성 프로그램에 구체적 시험법이 없어 기록 변경의 데이터무결성과 안정성시험 결과의 해석·품질평가에 영향을 줍니다.
observations.source_summary: Appropriate controls are not exercised over computers or related systems to assure that changes in master production and control records or other records are instituted only by authorized personnel.
